def factor_tail_stress_underwater_active_mean_vol120(df):
    """Volume-confirmed downside stress while underwater, averaged over active underwater days, with longer volume baseline."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']
    daily_ret = close.pct_change()
    downside_move = (-daily_ret).clip(lower=0.0)
    rolling_high = close.rolling(63, min_periods=10).max()
    underwater = close < rolling_high
    volume_ratio = volume / volume.rolling(120, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress = downside_move * volume_ratio.clip(upper=3.0)
    stress = stress.where(underwater, 0.0)
    stress_sum = stress.rolling(21, min_periods=5).sum()
    underwater_count = underwater.astype(float).rolling(21, min_periods=5).sum()
    factor = stress_sum / underwater_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return factor.rename('factor_tail_stress_underwater_active_mean_vol120')
description: Preserves parent's volume-confirmed downside stress while underwater mechanism, which gave RankICIR and payoff monotonicity. Bottleneck is low linear IC/ICIR from noise in volume baseline. Mutation increases volume baseline window from 60 to 120 with min_periods 20 to reduce sampling variance, targeting higher ICIR and IC stability while keeping the economic mechanism unchanged. Only one lightweight modifier: volume_ratio clip at 3.0 retained.
